body:
# Daily Spoiler & Precon Watch — 2026-11-11

This automated journal entry records the official Wizards/DailyMTG pages found during the 2026-11-11 scan and the upcoming Commander products already present in the tracker’s structured release calendar. It is a source index, not a claim that every spoiler page represents a complete decklist.

## What changed

The scan found **1 Commander/precon-related page**, **1 spoiler or card-preview page**, and **3 product/release pages**. New-to-Magic status, deck completeness, exact cards, and prices remain separate checks in the catalog refresh.

### Commander and precon announcements

- [Magic: The Gathering® | Star Trek™ Commander Decklists](https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/announcements/star-trek-commander-decklists) — commander announcement

### Spoilers and card previews

- [Magic: The Gathering® | Star Trek™ Tokens and Art Cards](https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/card-preview/star-trek-tokens-and-art-cards) — spoiler

### Upcoming Commander products already on the release radar

No upcoming Commander products were available in the structured calendar.

## How to use this in the tracker

Use the linked official page to confirm the announcement. Use the Commander Library to inspect a complete deck record when MTGJSON has one. Then open the deck’s upgrade paths to compare EDHREC-supported packages, your scanned copies, and cards that may be transferable from another owned precon. The automation does not infer ownership from an announcement.

## Data notes

- Official source index: [DailyMTG news](https://magic.wizards.com/en/news)
- Structured product source: MTGJSON SetList and DeckList, refreshed separately by the daily catalog jobs.
- Spoiler pages are evidence of an official page, not proof of a complete card list or a purchase recommendation.
dataWindow: Official DailyMTG page scan and structured release calendar checked 2026-11-11.
caveat: Automated source index. Verify complete decklists, exact printings, release dates, and prices before acting.
